title: PipelineProposal
description: A proposed pipeline (source + ordered transform steps + output DataType contract) produced by an agent (or a fixture). Carries NO ids — nothing is created until the proposal is applied by a future apply path (HEL-342). This schema/protocol is the foundation only; this ticket ships no apply route.

outputDataTypeName.description: Name of the DataType the applied pipeline's output will be registered under. Carries no dataTypeId — the id is minted at apply time.

steps.description: Ordered list of transform steps, applied in array order — mirrors the add_pipeline_step MCP tool's {type, config} contract and POST /api/pipelines/:id/steps.

PipelineProposalSource.description: Either a reference to an existing data source (sourceId) or an inline new-source spec (type/name/config). Both forms are representable at once — this schema does not enforce mutual exclusivity; resolving which branch wins when both are present is an apply-time (HEL-342) concern.

sourceId.description: Existing-source branch — id of a caller-owned DataSource to reuse as-is.

type.description: Inline-source branch — the new source's kind. Selects which shape `config` must conform to. A deliberate narrowing of the full connector registry (text/pdf/image excluded) per this ticket's scope.

name.description: Inline-source branch — the new source's display name.

config.description: Inline-source branch — the per-type config payload selected by `type`: csv -> {path}; rest_api -> {url, method?, auth?, headers?}; sql -> {dialect, host, port, database, user, password, query}; static -> {columns, rows}. A single shared property regardless of `type`, matching CreatePipelineStepRequest's config and DataSourceResponse's per-subtype config convention.

PipelineProposalStep.description: Same {type, config} shape POST /api/pipelines/:id/steps and add_pipeline_step already accept. `type` is intentionally left unconstrained here (not enumerated) — the backend's step-kind registry (PipelineStepKind.All) is the authoritative allow-list, checked at apply time, not by this schema. Current op set (for readability only, not exhaustive as the registry grows): rename, filter, join, compute, groupBy, cast, select, limit, sort, aggregate, splitText, extractHeadings, chunkByTokenCount, dateBucket, pivot, window, unpivot, dedupe, fillNull, stringOps, union, lookup.
